sloka: ते वृक्षानुदकं भूमिमाश्रमेषूटजांस्तथा ।न हिंस्युरिति तेनाहमेक एव समागत: ॥ २.९१.९॥
transliteration: te vṛkṣānudakaṁ bhūmimāśrameṣūṭajāṁstathā ।na hiṁsyuriti tenāhameka eva samāgata: ॥ 2.91.9॥

translations.english: Lest the army should damage the huts, trees, land, and defile the water in the ashram, I came here alone.
